Random effects that share one covariance matrix

Source: R/scaling.R
get_ranef_blocks.Rd

Usually, each outcome has its own random effects per grouping level, b_<outcome>_<lvl>, with covariance matrix D_<outcome>_<lvl>. With rd_vcov = "full", the random effects of several outcomes form one vector b_<lvl> with covariance matrix D_<lvl>; the attribute "ranef_index" of rd_vcov gives the positions of each outcome in it (e.g. "1:2").

Usage

get_ranef_blocks(info_list)

Arguments

info_list

list with the model information of each sub-model (get_model_info()).

Value

List with one element per covariance matrix: name (b_<name>, D_<name>), lvl (grouping level), and parts, one per outcome, with info (model info), lvl_info (hierarchical-centring information of the level) and cols (positions of the outcome's random effects).
